candidates.explanation: After verifying the reset hash, resetPassword only sets the new password and updates the user. It never deletes the user's existing sessions (e.g. sessionService.deleteByUserId). The phone's session record and its refresh-token hash stay valid, so refreshToken() can still renew the login after a reset.

fix.description: After the password update in resetPassword, delete all of the user's sessions with `await this.sessionService.deleteByUserId({ userId: user.id });`. The session service already provides this method.
